caption_L1: Here a bar chart is titled Number of average available hospital beds in Northern Ireland from 2009 to 2020. The x-axis measures Year while the y-axis plots Number of average available hospital beds.
caption_L2L3: Overall the trend of number of actual available beds in Northern Ireland is downwards. The number of available hospital beds in Northern Ireland was at its highest in 2009/10Between 2015 and 2018 the number of available hospital beds in Northern Ireland remained more or less constant at around 6,000 beds. Since 2018, the number of beds decreases slightly during the following two years.
